subject: Junior Estimator application, Marc Darenz Masarate
email_body:
Hi GLE team,

I'm applying for the Junior Estimator role in Hoppers Crossing advertised on SEEK.

I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design in February 2026, covering road geometry, earthworks, pavement and stormwater drainage in Civil 3D and AutoCAD, so I'm used to reading civil drawings and specifications. From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer, where I tracked procurement and materials and prepared material records and progress reports. I live in Melton, hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.

Your drainage work to Melbourne Water and council specifications is close to what I studied. I don't have estimating or tendering experience or Expert Estimation yet, so I would be starting at the junior end and learning your rates and systems.

Would you consider me for an interview? I've attached my resume and cover letter.

Marc Darenz Masarate
0478 764 077
macdarenz@gmail.com

letter.subject: Application for Junior Estimator, Water, Sewer and Drainage, Hoppers Crossing
paragraphs: I am applying for the Junior Estimator role at your Hoppers Crossing office, advertised on SEEK. I live in Melton, close to your office, and I want to build a career on the commercial side of civil infrastructure.

In February 2026 I completed an Advanced Diploma of Civil Construction Design at Albright Institute. The course covered road geometry, earthworks, pavement systems and stormwater drainage, with drawings prepared and reviewed in AutoCAD and Civil 3D against Australian Standards, so reading civil drawings and specifications is part of my training. I also hold a Bachelor of Science in Civil Engineering from the Philippines.

From April 2019 to February 2020 I worked on site in the Philippines as a project-in-charge engineer and then a field engineer. I tracked procurement and materials, prepared site reports, material records and progress reports, and coordinated with engineers, subcontractors and suppliers. I use Microsoft Office, and in my later technical support role I kept accurate notes on 40 to 60 cases a day.

I do not have estimating or tendering experience or Expert Estimation yet, so I would be learning your rates, take-off methods and tender process from the start. I hold a White Card and an Australian driver's licence with my own transport, and have full working rights on a Subclass 485 visa until December 2027.
Thank you for considering my application. I've attached my resume and cover letter, and my portfolio is at https://macdarenz-droid.github.io/Portfolio
